title_zh: 智行京张 P1-P9 用户与责任角色矩阵
title_en: Jing-Zhang P1-P9 Persona and Accountability Matrix
boundary: Personas are design roles, not a resident census, demographic claim or consent record.

roles.need: 不依赖 App 的连续通行、电话/纸面入口和人工解释
roles.mechanism_role: review ordinary route, waiting and complaint closure
roles.decision_right: may decline automation and request human service

roles.name_zh: 轮椅及行动辅助使用者
roles.need: 无障碍路线连续、无高差断点、可见接管
roles.mechanism_role: required accessibility reviewer at every node
roles.decision_right: any blocking break reopens the node

roles.need: 陪同、等待和替代入口不被自动化切断
roles.mechanism_role: test equivalent human service and consent withdrawal
roles.decision_right: can choose assisted or human-only path

roles.need: 低速、可解释边界和不采集不必要身份信息
roles.mechanism_role: review guardian confirmation and visible stop cues

roles.need: 照明、人工帮助、夜间撤回和不依赖手机的回程
roles.mechanism_role: review dark-hour route and staffed fallback
roles.decision_right: no trial when safe human return is unavailable

roles.need: 可复核的公开方法、匿名汇总和明确引用边界
roles.mechanism_role: replay package checks and publish limitations
roles.decision_right: cannot turn synthetic replay into field evidence

roles.need: 装卸、消防、工具和事件恢复空间不被占用
roles.mechanism_role: review curb windows, maintenance triggers and recovery
roles.decision_right: can hold a window for safety or access

roles.need: 公开状态、平等到达和不被强制注册
roles.mechanism_role: review legibility, public communication and redress
roles.decision_right: can use paper/phone or staffed entry

roles.need: 责任、停止规则、证据等级和事故复盘可追溯
roles.mechanism_role: own the gate, log the decision and authorize neither field operation nor scale without required evidence
roles.decision_right: may hold, reopen or return to human service
